From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novaprocure.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial W-9 + EIN info

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the W-9. I took a first pass; the document looks good but we need to run a few automated checks before we can release the vendor to PO status.

High-level on our side:
- Preferred bulk format: CSV with one line per legal entity + PO metadata. I'll attach our sample CSV template.
- Required CSV fields: legal_name, dba (optional), ein, address_line1, country, tax_classification, primary_contact_email, requested_po_number (if you have it), project_code (your internal mapping), and signed_w9_filename.
- We do accept secure SFTP drops to a per-customer path (details below).
- Before PO assignment we run an automated TIN/EIN normalization and matching step (we call it the N2 check) that validates format, removes punctuation and leading zeros when appropriate, and cross-references a third-party TIN database. This catches formatting mismatches like 12-3456789 vs 123456789.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Drop the CSV and all W-9 PDFs into the SFTP path: sftp://uploads.redwood-secure.example.com/novaprocure-ingest
2) Confirm whether you want us to auto-map POs using your project_code field, or have Procurement (monica.patel@redwood.com) approve mappings manually.
3) Indicate if any of the three records should be flagged for manual review (special tax residency or escrow requirements).

If you want, I'll loop Naomi in to confirm payment-team validation and timelines.

Thanks,
Logan
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Thanks Logan — sending the CSV in about an hour. We'd prefer automatic mapping using project_code (samples included). Two of the entities are US tax residents; one is a US branch of a foreign parent and will need a W-8BEN-E instead. I'll flag that record in the CSV with tax_classification = W8BEN-E and put a note in the comments column.

We will upload: vendor_onboarding_csv_template.csv and the three W-9/W-8 PDFs.

—Sarah

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: W9 pipeline staging and N2 checks for batch PO mapping

Looping in Payments here. Quick notes from Treasury / Payments:

- SFTP path is fine. We'll provision a one-time key for NovaProcure and rotate it after the initial load. Please use the path in related_links.
- We will run the N2 normalization + a third-party TIN verification (TaxCheck) as part of our ingestion job. If TaxCheck returns a soft mismatch we will queue that vendor for manual review and reach out with what failed.
- Required for auto-enablement: signed W-9 (wet or e-signed), EIN confirmation (bank letter or IRS CP575). For W-8BEN-E records we require both the form and an entity declaration for treaty benefits where applicable.
- ETA: We can process the first batch within 48 business hours after files land and hand back an ingestion report (success rows, rows flagged, error codes).

Monica — if Procurement wants manual approval on mapping step, let us know; otherwise we can auto-map based on project_code if the CSV contains the exact project_code strings used in Redwood's PO system.

Cheers,
Naomi
Director, Treasury Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novaprocure.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: W9 pipeline staging and N2 checks for batch PO mapping

Thanks all — this plan works for Procurement. A couple of operational items before you drop the files: 

- Please use the attached CSV template (vendor_onboarding_csv_template.csv) as-is. Do not change column headers; that will break the ingestion parser.
- Mark the W-8BEN-E row in the CSV with comments="foreign-branch - requires treaty docs" so our legal team can see it automatically.
- For POs to be created immediately we require requested_po_number to be populated for each line. If you don't have PO numbers yet, set requested_po_number to EMPTY and we'll create provisional PO numbers and email the assigned PO list back to you.

We'll also include a short ingest report (see legal_po_mapping_guidelines.pdf for column explanations). If anything is flagged we'll reach out to the Sarah/Kevin inbox within 24 hours.

Looking forward to the batch. Once files are up Naomi, please kick the ingestion job and paste the job run id into this thread so we have traceability.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
